1.name: Fried egg
instructions: Melt butter in pan over medium-low heat
Crack the egg into the buttered pan
Sprinkle the pinch of salt onto the cooking egg
Flip egg after about a minute and a half
Serve egg after about a minute and a half

2.name: Butter toast
instructions: Put the bread in the toaster
Take the toast out of the toaster
Put the pad of butter on the toasted bread
After a minute spread the melted butter onto the bread

3.name: Pancakes
instructions: Whisk the flour, sugar, and baking powder together
Mix in the egg, milk, and melted butter
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat
Pour batter into the pan and cook until bubbles form
Flip the pancake and cook until golden brown
Serve warm

4.name: Grilled cheese sandwich
instructions: Butter one side of each slice of bread
Place one slice of bread butter-side down in a pan
Add the cheese and top with the second slice of bread
Cook until the bottom is golden brown
Flip and cook until the cheese melts and the other side is golden brown
Slice and serve

5.name: Tomato pasta
5.description: Pasta tossed in a simple tomato sauce
instructions: Boil the pasta in salted water until tender
Warm the olive oil in a pan and cook the garlic briefly
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for five minutes
Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce
Toss until the pasta is coated
Top with parmesan and serve

6.name: Fruit smoothie
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender
Blend until smooth
Pour into a glass and serve immediately
